editorial.name: React Native Reanimated
editorial.descriptionZh: Software Mansion 维护的 React Native 动画库 Reanimated。动画默认跑在 UI 线程。文档站现为 4.x，包名 react-native-reanimated。仓库 LICENSE 标 MIT。
editorial.takeawayZh: 用共享值在 UI 线程播原生动画
editorial.noteZh: 首页大标题 React Native Reanimated 与 Get started。Getting started 写 4.x 只支持新架构，并给 npm install react-native-reanimated。Your First Animation 用 Animated.View 紫色方块示范。MIT。适合 React Native。

reasons.statement: 首页把 Reanimated 定义为 A powerful animation library that makes it easy to create smooth animations and interactions that run in the UI thread。
Your First Animation 用 import Animated from 'react-native-reanimated' 与 <Animated.View> 示范可动画组件。
